### Vital Farms to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 6, 2026


July 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/845857233/files/doc_news/2026/Vital-Farms-to-Report-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-on-August-6-2026.pdf)


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL), a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide, will report financial results for the second quarter ended June 28, 2026, on Thursday, August 6, 2026, before market open.


Vital Farms will host a conference call and webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET on the same day to discuss the results. To participate in the conference call via phone, participants may register for the call[here](https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/815869619?pwd=hnxf1mTa) to receive dial-in details and a unique pin.


Alternatively, participants may access the live webcast on the Vital Farms Investor Relations website at[https://investors.vitalfarms.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.globenewswire.com%2FTracker%3Fdata%3DQu8W9gXW-dB0MxBoiI4oN99i7piaoznoKiS2fnDJJHjKwRiHX_at6yVHNNFi6pU40bqGrwPWrU1a_alVCtGTo8rOkoE9-d3_bmwii0vFnaSXxLh6ZYbCSOVtvNhFMIo3&esheet=54575450&newsitemid=20260723908756&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.vitalfarms.com&index=2&md5=f388e6087f64f4b1a4a66915fd09ab78) under “Events.” The webcast will be archived for 30 days.


**About Vital Farms**


Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) is a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. Started on a single farm in Austin, Texas, in 2007, Vital Farms is now a national consumer brand that works with 625 small farms and is the leading U.S. brand of pasture-raised eggs by retail dollar sales. Vital Farms’ ethics are exemplified by its focus on the humane treatment of farm animals and sustainable farming practices. In addition, as a Delaware public benefit corporation, Vital Farms prioritizes the long-term benefits of each of its stakeholders, including farmers and suppliers, customers and consumers, communities and the environment, and crew members and stockholders. Vital Farms’ products, including shell eggs, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs, are sold in more than 23,500 stores nationwide. Vital Farms pasture-raised eggs can also be found on menus at hundreds of foodservice operators across the country. For more information, visit[https://vitalfarms.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fvitalfarms.com%2F&esheet=54575450&newsitemid=20260723908756&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fvitalfarms.com%2F&index=3&md5=68f5cb2418e6f46b12c2b14ac360d6e2) .
